subject.title: feat(ui): add message preview to session list

question: Should the narrow Control UI Sessions table preview land independently, or wait for the broader Sessions overview design?
rationale: The backend and TUI already support last-message previews, but the visible Control UI table design overlaps with broader open session-overview and derived-title requests.

options.title: Land a narrow replacement
options.body: Ask for or sponsor a focused rework against the current Control UI files using `includeLastMessage` and `lastMessagePreview`, with browser proof before merge.

options.title: Fold into broader overview
options.body: Keep the paired issue open but pause this PR until the broader Sessions overview design owns snippets, peek, and switching behavior together.

options.title: Reject table previews for now
options.body: Close this PR only after a maintainer states that the current Sessions table should remain an operations-style view without message snippets.

recommendation.title: Land a narrow replacement
recommendation.body: Ask for or sponsor a focused rework against the current Control UI files using `includeLastMessage` and `lastMessagePreview`, with browser proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The live Control UI Sessions surface and recent UI history make steipete the clearest routing candidate for this product choice.
